\section{About}
Computer Science and Engineering graduate from United International University, focused on bioinformatics. Research covers gene regulation, protein structure and function, and communication between cells. Also works in software development, machine learning, AI security, and embedded systems with computer vision. Values human-centric design, sound design principles, and clear system architecture. Teaches HSC students alongside research and has tutored since 2022. Aims to pursue advanced study and research, turning complex ideas into useful tools.

\section{Research Work}
\entry{Researcher (independent and collaborative)}{2024 - Present}
\sub{United International University \textbullet\ iOmicsLab}
\begin{itemize}
  \item \textbf{SLIM: Selective Memory and Leakage-Controlled Evaluation for Enhancer-Promoter Interaction Prediction.} Invented a new transformer architecture and processed large datasets.
  \item \textbf{Enhancer-Promoter Model Benchmarking:} Compares interaction prediction models across different architectures.
  \item \textbf{Holo-GeoN:} Predicts mutation effects on protein stability and disease, without using protein structures.
  \item \textbf{Protein Structure and Function:} Builds deep learning models for protein stability, interaction, and expression.
  \item \textbf{Cell-to-Cell Communication and Biological Encoders:} Builds encoders for biological signals.
  \item \textbf{Quantum Bioinformatics and ML Simulation:} Applies quantum methods and machine learning simulations to research.
  \item \textbf{Medical Imaging and Question Answering:} Offline chest X-ray triage and medical question answering for low-resource clinics. Uses small models and continual learning (Radflow Edge).
  \item \textbf{Model Context Protocol Servers:} Survey and benchmarks of server designs for sustainable computing.
  \item \textbf{Efficient Model Design:} Prototypes focused-bin transformer and Hierarchical Ancestral Memory Attention designs.
  \item \textbf{Smart Waste Routing:} Priority-weighted dynamic routing for IoT-based waste management in sustainable cities. Combines Random Forest urgency prediction (R\textsuperscript{2} about 0.93) with traffic-aware graph routing.
  \item \textbf{Waste Vehicle Routing:} Weight-based vehicle routing algorithms for waste collection.
  \item \textbf{NOVIS (Non-Optical Visual Inference System):} Embedded system that reconstructs grayscale images, metric depth, and inferred color without a camera. Uses a 32x24 thermopile array, ultrasonic ranges, and active chirp echoes. Produces a confidence map for inferred color.
  \item \textbf{iOmicsLab Platform:} Contributor to the open-source iOmicsLab platform.
\end{itemize}
